title: 1:1 prep - Sam Lee with Priya Shah
content:
Goal for this 1:1 (15-20m): quick sync on priorities, surface blockers, align on career/role goals and next steps for oncall handoff. Keep it focused: project updates (~5m), blockers (~5m), career & growth (~5m), quick wins / ask (~2-3m).

Agenda:
- Quick status: what shipped last week / this week plan
- Top blocker(s) and help needed
- Oncall readiness + rota (hand off to Maya)
- Career / growth check-in: expectations for IC4 -> staff path, timeline
- Action items & follow-ups

Current context / highlights:
- KV-cache optimization spike (INF-423): prototype landed, perf + memory profile looks promising. Seeing ~18% p50 latency improvement for 2048 token seqs in local perf harness but need larger cluster runs. PR #984 opened (serving-runtime).
- Quantization profiling for Llama-3-7B (INF-512): working through accuracy regressions on a few eval prompt sets (chatty e-commerce). Lower fp16->int8 config has ~2.4% drop on Rouge-like metric for short prompts. Running A/B on dedicated cluster next Tues.
- Dedicated autoscaler rollout: config is ready, still waiting on infra tickets (infra-237) to provision extra pool for canary traffic.

What I shipped since last 1:1:
- Merged initial KV-cache token deduping (PR 967) — reduces duplicate fetches for prefix-heavy workloads.
- Wrote the first draft of the canary test plan for autoscaler (doc linked above).

Metrics / Signals I'm watching (quick):
- Median generation latency (prod hostapi): 180ms -> target 160ms (work in progress)
- Deployment frequency: 3/week in serving-runtime
- CI flake rate: 4% (still noisy on tests around CUDA fallback)

Top blockers / asks:
1) Cluster-scale perf runs for KV-cache: need 2x p4d nodes for 24h runs to observe tail latencies. Who can help queue this? (Assigned: Priya / ask infra)
2) Infra ticket (infra-237) stuck in triage — blocking autoscaler canary start. Requesting escalation to SRE lead.
3) Quant eval set failures: need help from Applied ML team to inspect the 30 failing prompts that show hallucinations under int8. Can Priya connect me with Lina from applied-ml?

Risks / open questions:
- If int8 profile causes subtle hallucinations in longer context, we may need to hold rollout for chatty workloads; what's the business tolerance? (recommend: hold on chatty feature flags, proceed for short prompt paths)
- Oncall handoff: Maya has shadowed twice but hasn't run a full rotation. Plan: pair-run next Thurs, then official handoff the following week.

Career / growth notes (discuss):
- I'm targeting IC4->Staff (timeline: 9-12mo). Key gaps I see: broader product impact case studies, cross-team influence, and ownership of a measurable platform metric (e.g., 20% cost reduction through KV improvements).
- Ask: sponsor me for the platform-level roadmap review meeting and help set up 1-2 cross-team writeups I can lead.

Quick wins / asks for Priya:
- Can you escalate infra-237 to SRE lead? (short note in Slack or put on your 1:1 with Nav)
- Connect me to Lina (applied-ml) to triage the quant eval failures.
- Approve request for 2x p4d for a 24h run (I will provide scheduling window).

Action items (capture during 1:1):
- [PRIYA] Escalate infra-237 to SRE lead (due: 2026-03-04)
- [SAM] Schedule cluster perf runs & share windows with Priya (due: 2026-03-05)
- [PRIYA] Intro to Lina (applied-ml) for quant eval triage (due: 2026-03-04)
- [SAM] Draft cross-team one-pager for KV-cache impact and cost projection (due: 2026-03-10)
- [MAYA] Pair-run oncall with Sam (due: 2026-03-12)

Notes to self (if conversation goes long):
- If Priya asks about career examples, reference: lead of autoscaler roadmap + cost-savings projection doc.
- Be explicit about the trade-offs for int8: measurable cost reduction vs small accuracy regressions on specific prompt classes.
- Request 1:1 slot next week to follow-up on infra escalation and cluster run results.

Unresolved / parking lot items:
- Discussion about long-term strategy for model fallback policies (defer to product-hosted-api sync).
- Proposal to run automated evals as pre-merge checks for quant configs (follow-up with release-engineering).

References / links (quick):
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/984, https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/967
- JIRA: INF-423 (kv-cache opt), INF-512 (quant), infra-237
- Confluence: KV cache spike notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/kv-cache-opt

End of notes. Keep this doc updated after the 1:1 (capture new action items + decisions).
